description: Procurement for the supply of 48 Polyaxial MRI compatible (Titanium/Cobolt-Chrome) Lumber Pedicle Screws
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 48 Polyaxial MRI Compatible (Titanium/Cobalt-Chrome) Lumbar Pedicle Screws, which are used in spinal surgeries to stabilize the spine and promote fusion, deal with spinal deformities, and treat fractures and tumors and 03 bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Avenierr Pharma (Pvt) Ltd. of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Miraclus Orthotech (Pvt) Ltd., India) the only substantially responsive bidder for a total cost of Rs.136.32 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
